name: DUMBBELL CRUNCH AND PUNCHES
introduce: Lie on the floor with your knees bent and feet against a wall. Hold a dumbbell in each hand. \n\nRaise your shoulders up and alternately extend your left and right arm. Slowly go back to the starting position and repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please prepare two dumbbells and a mat.
Please don’t go further past your lumbar spine when raising up.
To make it more of a challenge, try not to rest your shoulders on the floor.
This exercise can greatly strengthen your abs and arms.
